subject.title: feat: add opt-in Nephesh dream provenance integration

question: Should OpenClaw add a vendor-specific Nephesh provenance setting to bundled Memory Core, or require the Nephesh project to consume the existing Dream Diary artifact through an external integration?
rationale: The request adds a new config option and a persistent machine-readable output format for an optional external memory system. The repository vision prefers optional capabilities outside core unless a missing extension seam justifies a generic upstream contract.

options.title: Externalize the Nephesh integration
options.body: Have Nephesh own an importer, plugin, or sidecar that treats `DREAMS.md` as generated dream material without adding a Nephesh-specific core setting.

options.title: Sponsor a generic provenance contract
options.body: Narrow the proposal to vendor-neutral Dream Diary provenance metadata, with a documented schema and compatibility tests for existing readers.

options.title: Keep the current artifact contract
options.body: Retain the existing human-reviewable Dream Diary output and decline a new provenance surface until stronger cross-integration demand appears.

recommendation.title: Externalize the Nephesh integration
recommendation.body: Have Nephesh own an importer, plugin, or sidecar that treats `DREAMS.md` as generated dream material without adding a Nephesh-specific core setting.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available feature-history routing candidate for Dreaming and its diary/promotion contract.
